findings.title: Site served over plain HTTP
findings.description: Target is served over plain HTTP.
findings.impact: Traffic is unencrypted and modifiable in transit.
findings.remediation: Serve the site over HTTPS and redirect HTTP->HTTPS.

findings.title: Missing content-security-policy header
findings.description: The content-security-policy header is not set on this response. This is a missing defense-in-depth control, not a confirmed vulnerability.
findings.remediation: Define a Content-Security-Policy to mitigate XSS and data injection.

findings.remediation: Set X-Frame-Options: DENY/SAMEORIGIN or CSP frame-ancestors.

findings.title: Password form submits over plain HTTP
findings.description: A form containing a password field posts to 'http://127.0.0.1:8099/login' over unencrypted HTTP.
findings.impact: Credentials can be intercepted in transit.
findings.remediation: Serve and post the login form over HTTPS.

findings.title: robots.txt discloses 2 disallowed paths

findings.impact: May point to admin or internal areas.
findings.remediation: Do not rely on robots.txt for access control.
